baselineRegression.method: Sixteen targeted final tests against isolated turn-start AppContext, Settings and settingsKeys copies. Twelve parameterized failures, four passes. Other fourteen cases excluded from this baseline-only run. Tests execute production expressions/components with mocked dependencies; not twelve independent defects.

changes: Reasoning and vision preference saves reuse one implementation with independent serial queues. Pending writes merge with the last confirmed state, not optimistic drafts; failed saves leave confirmed selection active. Older saves no longer report false merely because a later save was requested.

One preference application callback replaces duplicate startup/event hydration and save-confirmation normalization, state/ref updates and cache writes. Removed the delayed reasoning ref synchronization effect.

Credentials must be saved and verified before submitting model selection. Keys remain write-only, never enter model preferences or browser configuration. Account-generation changes/unmount prevent queued sends and stale UI commits.

Both preference saves and credential write/read-back share a 15-second AbortSignal starting when that queued operation executes. A failed or timed-out operation releases its queue without automatic write retry.
Incomplete confirmations are rejected; corrupt/non-object browser model maps fall back to an empty map, and browser cache write failures do not report a confirmed server save as failed.

Cloud/local provider rows reuse model draft, confirmed-value rollback, duplicate test locking and request ownership. Old failures cannot roll back later edits. Model/address/key-state/account changes and unmount invalidate obsolete connection-test state.
Removed a now-vacuous source-string assertion and redundant AppContext source read from model_switching_stability; route-policy preservation is exercised by the new production-function behavior test.
preserved: Role-specific default models and backend preference routes, official reasoning alias normalization, explicit provider/model selections, inactive provider choices and fallback policy.
Reasoning and vision remain independently configurable; one blocked role does not block the other.
Existing settings entry points, local service discovery, cloud credential controls and authenticated API transport remain in place.
limitations: Automatic regression uses production component/function extraction, mocked transports and isolated backend fixtures; no full AppProvider/native-client end-to-end acceptance, real model calls, visual checks, latency benchmark or full-suite rerun.

Queues are per mounted AppProvider and role, not multi-client/database transactions. Accepted server writes or credential changes cannot be undone by client cancellation, account change or timeout. A lost acknowledgement can leave server state requiring a later refresh.

The 15-second deadline begins at execution, not enqueue. Pending per-keystroke writes are still not coalesced. Reasoning-route, world-model and retrieval-test panels still have separate result state/lifecycle handling.
Model preference browser caches are not account-keyed. Personal-case cache isolation, case-write coalescing and other program areas remain open.
No backend source change or backend rebuild this batch; no commit, push, native client restart or edits to real user settings/data.
